# Plan Comparison

`comparison/plan-comparison` &middot; section-level &middot; category: comparison

## Purpose

Pricing plans side by side: each plan's name and price on top, feature rows, and a button under each plan.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `plans` | list of object { name, price, period, highlight, cta } (2 to 4) |  |
| `rows` | list of object { label, values } (1 to 20) |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` | text |  |
| `intro` | text |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Plans with hairline rows.
- **zebra**: Alternating row shading. Sets `tableVariant: zebra`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `tableVariant` | one of `default`, `zebra`, `tinted` | `"default"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tables, colors and borders honored. | Fine. Columns shrink on phones. | Cells on the surface or background swap via dm-* classes. Header cells keep their colors. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('comparison/plan-comparison', {
  "heading": "Choose your plan",
  "plans": [
    {
      "name": "Starter",
      "price": "$9",
      "period": "/mo",
      "cta": {
        "label": "Start free",
        "href": "https://example.com/signup?plan=starter"
      }
    },
    {
      "name": "Team",
      "price": "$29",
      "period": "/mo",
      "highlight": true,
      "cta": {
        "label": "Try Team",
        "href": "https://example.com/signup?plan=team"
      }
    },
    {
      "name": "Business",
      "price": "$79",
      "period": "/mo",
      "cta": {
        "label": "Talk to us",
        "href": "https://example.com/contact"
      }
    }
  ],
  "rows": [
    {
      "label": "Projects",
      "values": [
        "5",
        "Unlimited",
        "Unlimited"
      ]
    },
    {
      "label": "Team members",
      "values": [
        "1",
        "10",
        "Unlimited"
      ]
    },
    {
      "label": "Shared workspaces",
      "values": [
        "no",
        "yes",
        "yes"
      ]
    },
    {
      "label": "Priority support",
      "values": [
        "no",
        "partial",
        "yes"
      ]
    }
  ]
}) ]]
```
